Tecsack Software | Titan Printer — Company Profile

Section: TECSACK SOFTWARE > 1. Overview

Titan Printer is a native Android driver application that connects a Bluetooth ESC/POS thermal receipt

printer to Android's built-in print system, so existing point-of-sale, ticketing, and business apps can print

receipts and labels to a thermal printer without any custom printer integration of their own.

Once installed, Titan Printer registers itself as a standard Android printer. From that point on, the

thermal printer shows up as a regular printer choice in the native Android "Print" dialog from any app on

the device. Titan Printer receives the document behind the scenes, renders it, and streams it to the

paired thermal printer over Bluetooth.

Section: TECSACK SOFTWARE > 2. Business Context

Retail, hospitality, and field-service businesses running handheld or countertop Android devices

typically need to:

•
Print receipts, tickets, or labels from apps that were never built with thermal-printer support

•
Connect to compact Bluetooth thermal printers without adding a vendor-specific SDK to every app

•
Keep printing reliable over Bluetooth, including automatic reconnection when a connection drops

•
Support multiple copies of the same receipt or ticket from a single print request

•
Keep a simple record of what has recently been printed

Building native thermal-printer support into every business app individually is costly and printer-specific.

Titan Printer solves this once, as a shared system-level driver: any app that can already print through

Android prints straight to the thermal printer, with no per-app integration work.

Section: TECSACK SOFTWARE > 4. Functional Modules > 4.1 Android Print Service Registration

•
Titan Printer registers a system print service that appears as a selectable printer in the Android print
picker

•
Any app that supports standard Android printing can send a job to it without knowing a thermal printer
is involved

•
Each print job is picked up by the service and handed off to the Bluetooth printing pipeline

Section: TECSACK SOFTWARE > 4. Functional Modules > 4.2 Bluetooth Discovery & Pairing

•
On first run, the app scans for and automatically pairs with the configured thermal printer over
Bluetooth

•
A previously paired connection is reused on later print jobs

•
The app can unpair and re-pair the printer to recover from a stuck connection, with manual pairing
through the device's Bluetooth settings available as a fallback

Section: TECSACK SOFTWARE > 4. Functional Modules > 4.3 Document Rendering for Thermal Output

•
Incoming print documents are rendered page by page into an image

•
Multiple pages are stitched into a single continuous image, matching how thermal receipt printers print
continuous rolls rather than discrete pages

•
Blank or empty edges are trimmed before printing to avoid wasting paper

Section: TECSACK SOFTWARE > 4. Functional Modules > 4.4 Bluetooth Transmission to the Printer

•
The rendered image is converted into thermal-printer commands and streamed to the printer over its
Bluetooth connection

•
The requested number of copies is printed in sequence from a single job

•
A paper feed is issued after each copy for a clean tear-off

Section: TECSACK SOFTWARE > 4. Functional Modules > 4.5 Connection Resilience

•
If the Bluetooth connection fails mid-print, the app automatically retries for a short window before
reporting a failure

Section: TECSACK SOFTWARE > 7. Technology Stack

Platform
Native Android (Java)

Printer Communication
Bluetooth connection to an ESC/POS thermal receipt printer

Print Integration
Android's system Print Service framework, so the printer appears as a native
Android printer

Document Rendering
Android's built-in PDF rendering, used to convert incoming print documents into
printable images

Printer Command Layer
Open-source ESC/POS command libraries for thermal-printer output

User Interface
Native Android screens for Home, Print History, and About

Section: TECSACK SOFTWARE > 8. Value Delivered

•
Turns a Bluetooth ESC/POS thermal printer into a standard Android system printer, usable by any app
without custom integration

•
Removes the need for individual business apps to build their own thermal-printer support

•
Automatically renders multi-page documents into the continuous format thermal printers expect

•
Keeps printing reliable with automatic Bluetooth reconnect and retry

•
Gives staff a simple connection status and test-print tool, plus a running history of recent print jobs
